mechanism: Both drugs are vesicular monoamine transporter 2 (VMAT2) inhibitors with overlapping pharmacodynamic effects on monoamine depletion, increasing risk of additive adverse effects including sedation, akathisia, and parkinsonism.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if treatment of different indications is necessary, use only one VMAT2 inhibitor and monitor closely for excessive monoamine depletion effects.
